Hi @eng-21, regarding LEDGERLIB-115: The design review note confirms that day counts are inclusive on both ends. For period 2024-03-01..2024-03-31, the count is 31 days. A customer active from 2024-03-31 through period_end is billed for 1 day (the active day count runs from active_date through period_end, inclusive). Hope that helps!

Hi @eng-22! Sure, for parse_amount, it was agreed that commas are only accepted in real thousands positions: the first group has 1-3 digits and every following group exactly 3 digits (e.g., '1,234,567.00'). Input like '1,23.00' or '12,3456' must raise a ValueError.
